name: typed-field-value-schema
title: Chemd typed field value schema unification
description: Unify Chemd block field value schema metadata across core, parser, typechecker, language-service, docs, and drift tests without changing existing compile behavior.
scope: packages/core schema, parser field parsing, typechecker normalization, language-service IDE metadata, apps/docs language docs, drift tests
creator: hzb666
notes: Trellis loop on develop. Phase 1 must be behavior-preserving metadata and drift tests only; parser AST, typechecker typed graph, diagnostics, exports, and docs examples must not drift.

phase_0.summary: Added current behavior baseline tests and parser docs describing raw field values before typed schema migration.

phase_1.summary: Added additive core FieldValueSchema metadata, read-only schema helpers, tests, and codebase docs without changing consumers.

phase_2.summary: Added schema coverage tests, enum drift guards, coarse domain field exceptions, and language fundamentals docs.

phase_3.summary: Replaced language-service value completion registry with schema-derived suggestions while preserving existing visible completions.
